Pin the selected envelope/revision for the read lifetime, validate immediately before each GET and after the bounded response body, refuse redirects, and revalidate before returning a complete snapshot. A provider401/403 invalidates the complete snapshot and aborts outstanding read requests instead of skipping a denied blob.
